goal: Expand paired synthetic pose references with hand-on-hip and seated groups while preserving existing material IDs and standing images.

throughputCheckpoint.blockingFirstSteps: Agree exact group/material IDs, per-study camera/depth ranges and manifest registry before edits.
throughputCheckpoint.independentWorkstreams: Feature owner owns catalog/docs/MCP integration, asset worker owns renderer/PNGs/manifests, validator worker owns explicit registry/provenance guard. Root owns independent browser and asset verification.
throughputCheckpoint.sharedMutableState: Each renderer, catalog, validator and browser artifact has one writer.
throughputCheckpoint.smallestSafeDecomposition: One coupled feature owner with two disjoint workers, plus root verification.

verification.renderer: python3 scripts/generate-pose-study.py --check passed for all 3 studies, 12 cameras and 24 PNGs.
verification.standingCompatibility: Root independently compared all 8 standing PNG files with Git commit 27f0eec; byte-identical.
verification.independentReview: No confirmed defects. Analytic projected bounds independently show every complete ellipsoid fits each frame and depth range; group isolation and declared source paths confirmed.
visualInspection: Hand-on-hip front lineart and three-quarter depth
Seated profile lineart and back depth

implementation.provenance: Explicit registry for all three original CC0 studies; no automatic discovery or trust from catalog values.
implementation.persistence: Exact material IDs remain compatible with v1 recipes, drafts, history and read-only MCP.

limitations: All new references are original synthetic mannequin geometry and normalized orthographic depth, not human scans or measured distances.
The seated pose intentionally has no stool asset; prompts do not claim one.
Python NumPy/Pillow are only required for explicit asset regeneration, not normal production builds.
